item.description:
Edith 1.2.2

Icon refinement

  • The stitched letter E now reads cleaner: the white running-stitch dashes inside the letter are gone, leaving the gold satin stitching, fabric, and patch border unchanged.

Edith 1.2.1

A new stitched icon

  • Edith debuts a new app icon: an embroidered letter E, satin-stitched in gold thread on lavender fabric with a sewn patch border.

Edith 1.2.0

Automatic updates

  • Edith now updates itself via Sparkle. Check manually with Edith ▸ Check for Updates…, or manage automatic checks and downloads in Settings ▸ Updates.

Quit & Resume

  • Quitting no longer interrupts you with save dialogs: open documents — including untitled ones and unsaved changes — are backed up and restored exactly as you left them on the next launch. Turn this off in Settings ▸ General.
  • Reopening files across launches now works reliably in the sandbox via security-scoped bookmarks.
  • The session is saved continuously while you work, so documents also come back after a crash.
  • The stray empty window that could appear next to restored documents is gone.
